title: Wound Dressings for Hidradenitis Suppurativa
brief_summary: The primary purpose of this research is to determine how the types of wound dressings affect quality of life for people with Hidradenitis Suppurativa (HS).
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Men and women ≥18 years of age
* Diagnosed with Hidradenitis Suppurativa (all stages of disease) by Dermatologist
* Presence of at least one lesion with active drainage
* Willing and able to provide informed consent

Exclusion Criteria:

* Subjects younger than 18-years-old.
* Prisoners
* Pregnant or lactating women
* Adults unable to consent
